items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: Mr. Tasso tried to teach me but I never could get my heart to learn the music

ctx.x: When did you start in music?

I was about 10 years old, I think, when I started to play. Did you start on the horn or something? No, drums. Drums? Yeah, I was a drummer for maybe three or four years. And then in high school, I just had a desire to play a bass. And there was a bass available there in the school, belonging to the school. And there was an old gentleman named Emil Tasso, who was formerly to conduct at the Orphium Theatre. And when they abandoned the stage shows, vaudeville, well naturally the orchestras were let out, you see. And…
Is that the fellow composed some of those numbers?
